scripts.title: Project Khaos
scripts.features:
🎯 Aimbot
Aimbot – lock‑on target with FOV circle

Trigger Bot – auto‑fires when locked on

Anti‑Recoil – compensates recoil

Hitbox Extender – multiplier slider to enlarge hitboxes

Prediction – lead moving targets (adjustable time)

Lock Strength – slider to control aim smoothness

🏃 Movement
Speed Hack – custom WalkSpeed (16–500)

Click Teleport – teleport to mouse click location

Low Gravity – reduce workspace gravity

Bunny Hop – auto‑jump while moving

Strafe Bot – automatic side‑to‑side movement when locked on

Noclip – walk through walls

Fly – free flight (WASD + Space/Shift)

Infinite Jump – jump repeatedly in the air

Jetpack – hold Space to boost upward

⚔️ Combat
Rapid Fire – faster shooting

Infinite Ammo – never run out

Spin Bot – rotate your character (adjustable speed)

Kill Aura – attack enemies within a custom range

Auto Reload – reload automatically when empty

Quick Switch – swap to secondary weapon on empty

Auto Execute – finish downed players

Auto W+S – follow a selected player (forward/backward bounce)

👁️ ESP & Visuals
ESP Master – toggle all ESP elements

2D Boxes – rectangles around enemies

Skeleton – lines connecting body parts

Tracers – lines from screen center to enemies

Chams – glowing outline/highlight on enemies

Weapon ESP – display enemy’s equipped tool

Health Text – show exact HP

Distance Rainbow – colour changes with distance

Radar – minimap showing nearby players

ESP Color Panel – pick from 10 preset colours or clear

🧪 Experimental
Lag Switch – freeze character periodically (adjustable delay)

Ghost Mode – make yourself locally invisible

A‑Train – sprint forward with high speed

⚙️ Utility
Third Person – toggle third‑person camera

FOV Unlock – change field of view

Freecam – detach camera and fly around

Auto Clicker – spam left‑click at custom CPS

Time Control – change in‑game time of day

Anti‑AFK – auto‑jump to prevent idle kicks

Auto Respawn – instantly respawn after death

Lag Optimizer – periodic memory cleanup

🔐 Key System
Compact, draggable key panel with Discord invite copy button

Enter the key KHAOS‑42‑A1B2 to unlock all features

Key panel can be minimized or closed

🛡️ Always Active
Anti‑Cheat Bypass – simulates ground contact, smooths speed, clamps velocity, normalises jump power to avoid fly/speed/jump detections

Watermark – small “Project Khaos v4.0” badge (visible after unlock)

⌨️ Keybinds
Every feature has a 🔑 button to assign a custom keyboard shortcut

Mouse buttons and the X key are blocked from binds to prevent accidental toggles

Title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

-- 3. Kotak Putih Tempat Ketik Script
TextBox.Name = "ScriptBox"
TextBox.Parent = MainFrame
TextBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 245) -- Putih
TextBox.Position = UDim2.new(0.04, 0, 0.1, 0)
TextBox.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 150)
TextBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
TextBox.MultiLine = true
TextBox.Text = "----remake-by-Rudooxxk\n"
TextBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
TextBox.TextSize = 14
TextBox.Font = Enum.Font.Code
TextBox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
TextBox.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top

UICorner2.Parent = TextBox
UICorner2.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

-- Fungsi otomatis buat bikin tombol biar rapi
local function buatTombol(nama, teks, pos, size, warnaBckg, warnaTeks, ukuranTeks)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Name = nama
    btn.Parent = MainFrame
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = warnaBckg
    btn.Position = pos
    btn.Size = size
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    btn.Text = teks
    btn.TextColor3 = warnaTeks
    btn.TextSize = ukuranTeks
    
    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
    corner.Parent = btn
    return btn
end

-- Warna hijau gelap untuk tombol bawah sesuai gambar 3249.png
local warnaTombolHijau = Color3.fromRGB(45, 75, 45) 

-- 4. Membuat Tombol-Tombol
local ExecBtn = buatTombol("ExecutorBtn", "executor", UDim2.new(0.04, 0, 0.75, 0), UDim2.new(0, 85, 0, 35), warnaTombolHijau, Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0), 16)
local ClearBtn = buatTombol("ClearBtn", "clear", UDim2.new(0.24, 0, 0.75, 0), UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 35), warnaTombolHijau, Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0), 16)
local ResetBtn = buatTombol("ResetBtn", "Reset avatar", UDim2.new(0.43, 0, 0.75, 0), UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 35), warnaTombolHijau, Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0), 15)

-- Tombol kecil "infinite yield" di pojok kanan bawah kotak putih
local InfYieldBtn = buatTombol("InfYieldBtn", "infinite yield", UDim2.new(0.34, 0, 0.62, 0), UDim2.new(0, 75, 0, 16), Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), 10)

-- ==================== FUNGSI TOMBOL ====================

-- Fungsi Tombol Executor (Menjalankan script yang kamu ketik di kotak putih)
ExecBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local sukses, errorMsg = pcall(function()
        assert(loadstring(TextBox.Text))()
    end)
    if not sukses then
        warn("Script Error: " .. tostring(errorMsg))
    end
end)

-- Fungsi Tombol Clear (Menghapus semua teks di kotak putih)
ClearBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    TextBox.Text = ""
end)

-- Fungsi Tombol Reset Avatar (Mereset karakter kamu)
ResetBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local p = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    if p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        p.Character.Humanoid.Health = 0
    end
end)

-- Fungsi Tombol Infinite Yield (Auto loadscript Infinite Yield asli)
InfYieldBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EdgeY0/infiniteyield/master/source'))()
end)

scripts.features:
1. Core Automation Features

These features handle the repetitive tasks required to build and maintain a tycoon.

Auto Buy: Automatically detects and purchases available items in your tycoon as they become available.

Auto Upgrade: Automatically handles the upgrading process for your tycoon's assets up to level 100.

Auto Rebirth: Automatically triggers the "Rebirth" function for your tycoon, allowing you to reset for bonuses without manual input.

2. Farming & Resource Management

These tools help you gather currency or items found around the game map.

Auto Lemon (Fruit Collection): Automatically teleports your character to "LemonTree" objects and uses the ClickDetector to collect fruit. It also disables collision on these trees to ensure smooth movement.

Auto Collect Bags: Automatically detects and teleports the character to money bags or cash items dropped around the map to collect them quickly.

Auto Phone Deals: Scans the in-game phone interface and automatically accepts deals/options provided by the game, saving you from manually clicking through the menus.

3. Utility & Navigation

Teleport System: Provides a pre-configured list of fast-travel buttons to key locations, including:

Points of Interest: Vine Key, Vine Door, Exit Sewers, UFO Key, Alien, and Void Altar.

Base Return: A dedicated button to teleport you back to your starting tycoon location.

Anti-AFK: Includes logic to detect if the game is about to kick you for being idle, simulating user input (moving/jumping) to keep you active.

Auto Rejoin: Attempts to automatically reconnect you to the server if the game errors or crashes.

4. User Interface & Tracking

Key System: A security layer requiring a specific key to unlock the full menu, with a quick-link button to join a Discord server.

Monitoring GUI: An on-screen status monitor that tracks:

Current FPS.

Real-time Cash count.

Statistics of actions performed (Total buys, upgrades, rebirths, and phone deals).

Visual indicators (ON/OFF) for all active automation toggles.

Customizability: The interface is fully draggable and contains organized tabs (Main, Farm, Teleports) for easy navigation.
